description: A reference-modified UNSTRING sending operand — a COBOL-2002 relaxation of a COBOL-85 restriction, QUOTED from ISO/IEC 1989:2002 Annex F.2 item 139: "UNSTRING statement. The sending operand may be reference modified." COBOL-85 is the edition a 2002 Annex F.2 'formerly' statement describes: the owner's decision of 2026-10-31 (kb/Work PB4305) makes the F.2 statements the rule for the 85 edge, as D-SIGN2 (item 124) and PB3683 (item 123) did; GnuCOBOL -std=cobol85 accepts some of them as dialect leniency, which rule 1 places below the ISO text. Gated in ONE place, VersionConformancePass.ParseArm.VisitUnstringStatement (kb/Work PB4305; VCR row 7.47).
citation: §1985:VI.6.27.3 SR7 ("Identifier-1 must not be reference modified", deleted); ISO §2023:14.9.48.3; ISO/IEC 1989:2002 Annex F.2 item 139
